summary: Hydro One Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, attaching a news release announcing the release of its 2025 Sustainability Report. The report details safety performance, Indigenous procurement (exceeding 5% spend target), and transmission system builds in Ontario. There are no transaction terms, board recommendations, advisors, or structural mechanics. The filing is a routine disclosure of a sustainability report, not a special situation. In US-equivalent terms, this is comparable to a voluntary 8-K disclosing ESG highlights. No risk-arb angle or event to watch for.
